feature_matches.source_problem: 小户型和宿舍空间有限，桌面和地面空间不足，需高效利用垂直空间和窄缝。
feature_selection_reason: 可拆卸隔板和可叠加使用适合小空间的灵活组合
壁挂式设计节省地面和桌面空间
可旋转、可折叠功能提高使用便利性和多功能性

candidate_product_concepts.concept_definition: A wall-mounted organizer with foldable and detachable shelves that can be adjusted to fit various items, maximizing vertical space in small living areas.
cost_risk_notes: Material cost needs to be managed to maintain affordability
Complex folding mechanism may increase production cost
compliance_risk_notes: Ensure wall-mounting complies with building regulations
Avoid using materials that may not pass safety standards

summary: The selected features focus on maximizing vertical space and flexibility in small living environments. The proposed product concept leverages foldable, detachable, and wall-mounted features to address space constraints effectively.
